visual_brief: Lakhta Center is a tapering blue-glass tower whose twisting facets converge into a sharp needle, with low angular glass wings at its base. Classic views look across the waterfront or along the beach in northwestern St. Petersburg, showing the complete tower above its low complex. Distinguish it from Moscow’s clustered towers, the smoother Lotte World Tower, and proposed Lakhta sister-tower renderings.
notes: Seven verified original-size JPEGs retained. Best choice: c6; alternatives: c1 and c4. Licence labels are transcribed from source pages and link to https://www.pexels.com/license/. References were viewed only. Downloads used Node after curl TLS failed; the repository follow-up check could not run because its configured Python interpreter is missing.
